title: Provision of Lightning Conductor at Thottappally Lighthouse
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for installing a copper-strip lightning conductor and copper plate earthing on the trestle tower of Thottappally Lighthouse, Alappuzha, Kerala, with materials supplied by the department, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Thottappally Lighthouse, Thottapally Fishing Harbour, Thottappally, Alappuzha - 688561
sites.work: Provision of lightning conductor and earthing on trestle tower

scope.item: Earthing with copper earth plate 600x600x3 mm incl. masonry enclosure, locking cover, 2.7 m watering pipe, charcoal/salt (without materials)
Excavation for earth strip laying, removal and refixing of paver blocks, construction of earth pit chamber with materials
Double cup-lock scaffolding on exterior up to seven storey height
Labour for annealing copper strip and plate, fabrication of clamps, fabrication of 2 m C-class GI pipe with flange and top cover for air conductor, misc civil works, soldering
Fixing 25x6 mm prefabricated copper clamps along trestle tower and copper earth strip with brazing of joints
Transportation of all items from Deep Bhavan, Cochin to Thottappally Lighthouse through courier (materials provided by department)

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam. Small scale industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate for related stores/service exempt. 100% payment within 30 days of satisfactory completion. Rates to show basic cost and taxes separately; L1 on consolidated total.

period.completion: Supply within 60 days from date of supply/work order
period.bid_validity: 60 days from date of opening of quotations

eligibility: Reputed OEM or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
Company/service engineers with minimum 3 years experience in relevant field
Documents: NSIC/MSME certificate or EMD; work experience of equivalent or higher value; last 3 years ITR; PAN; GST registration
specs: 1.5 m copper air electrode with spikes (heavy duty) on 2 m C-class GI pipe with flange/base plate fixed to top trestle platform with 12 mm GI bolt; zinc primer and 2 coats synthetic enamel
25 x 6 mm copper strip down-conductor along one main leg of trestle tower with fabricated copper clamps; joints overlapped, brazed and bolted
25 x 6 mm copper strip in 40 mm GI medium pipe to earth electrode, 0.5 m below ground
Copper earth plate 600 x 600 x 3 mm with 2.7 m watering pipe, charcoal/coke and salt or backfill compound; ER test of lightning conductor and earthing
